label: Production V1.1
releaseNotes: Station ID now uses a searchable dropdown that still accepts typed custom values.
The Station ID list now shows the full available catalog from the bundled station options file.
Archive naming now groups the final .gz name, naming options, example, and preview in one clearer section.
Archive names can optionally append Network and Referral DateTime using system-safe formatting.
The app now remembers user settings, upload-related config, and installer folder choices more like a full production app.
